versions.content: If the source transport protocol module reports an error using PduR_<User:LoTp>RxIndication , the PDU Router module shall not perform any error handling other than forwarding the indication to the upper layer module.

If the source Transport Protocol module reports an error using PduR_<User:LoTp>RxIndication , the PDU Router module shall not perform any error handling other than forwarding the RxIndication to the upper layer module.
